Evaluation & Metrics.content: Evaluasi dilakukan secara manual karena ukuran dataset, mengukur akurasi akhir QA tanpa metrik presisi‑recall terperinci.
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: we opt for manual evaluations. This approach ensures more accurate assessments and minimizes the risk of misjudgments.

Main Results.content: MultiFinRAG mencapai akurasi 90.4% pada pertanyaan berbasis teks, meningkat 15.1 poin persentase dibanding baseline.

Gap.content: Tidak disebutkan evaluasi faithfulness atau abstention pada dokumen perbankan berbahasa Indonesia. Financial documents--such as 10-Ks, 10-Qs, and investor presentations--span hundreds of pages and combine diverse modalities, including dense narrative text, structured tables, and complex figures. Answering questions over such content often requires joint reasoning across modalities, which strains traditional large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines due to token limitations, layout loss, and fragmented cross-modal context. We introduce MultiFinRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework purpose-built for financial QA. It will nor- malize heterogeneous table formats into a lightweight database, expose a natural-language interface for precise data retrieval, and feed the resulting rows and aggregates directly into our RAG generator as structured context. • Cross-Document & Longitudinal Analysis: Many financial queries require comparisons over multiple time periods or across related filings (e.g., 10-K vs. 10-Q). T-RAG [5] orga- nizes retrieval hierarchically through tree-based entity structures, while MoG (Mix-of-Granularity) [31] and DRAGIN [22] dynamically control chunk sizes and retrieval timing based on query character- istics and generation behavior. We introduce MultiFinRAG, a retrieval-augmented genera- tion framework purpose-built for financial QA. MultiFinRAG first performs multimodal extraction by grouping table and figure images into batches and sending them to a lightweight, quantized open- source multimodal LLM, which produces both structured JSON outputs and concise textual summaries. These outputs, along with narrative text, are embedded and indexed with modality-aware similarity thresholds for precise retrieval.
